build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for mixture of experts
merge_mole_model_escnmd_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into a single linear layer for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific MOLE experts using a mapping
build_dataset_specific_single_head_wrapp: build a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares one head across multiple datasets with named output routing
set_mole_coefficients_backbone: set MOLE expert mixing coefficients on the eSCNMDMoeBackbone using atomic numbers, batch, and CSD embeddings
